description: This file contains the implementation of the CustomField class within the Opencart Catalog Account namespace. It defines a controller that handles fetching custom fields for a specific customer group in the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: A controller class responsible for retrieving custom fields based on customer group and returning the data as JSON.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the HTTP request to fetch custom fields for the current customer group, compiles the data, and outputs it in JSON format.
